events.subtitle: Presents Q Theory — Robtober
events.factual_description: Blue Note Jazz Club presents Robert Glasper X Wyclef Presents Q Theory on Thursday and Friday, October 22-23, 2026, with 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM sets each night. Blue Note identifies the engagement as part of Glasper's seventh Robtober residency and confirms Glasper and Wyclef as the advertised artists; no additional live personnel are currently published on the event page. Wyclef Jean released Q Theory - Quantum Leap, Vol. 2 on August 28, 2026. The project's official release announcement describes it as his first jazz album, a tribute to Quincy Jones, and the introduction of Wyclef's 'Rara Jazz' concept combining Haitian/Caribbean rhythmic identity with jazz-fusion improvisation. Robert Glasper appears on three album tracks: 'Rocinha,' 'French Quarter,' and 'Farafina.' The live billing therefore directly reconnects two principal collaborators from the newly released project, but the sources do not establish that the full album or its studio guest roster will be performed live.

en.why_it_matters: This is a much stranger proposition than a celebrity crossover. Wyclef has just made his first jazz record around Haitian Rara rhythm, diaspora movement and a tribute to Quincy Jones, and Glasper is already inside that music on three tracks. Putting the two of them together during Robtober gives the project an intimate live laboratory: jazz improvisation meeting a musician whose whole career has treated Caribbean, hip-hop, pop and global music as one porous language.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the four sets if New York is in the corridor. Two nights give enough flexibility to fold it into a broader city trip rather than forcing the entire Northeast itinerary around a single seating.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es bastante más raro que un cruce de celebridades. Wyclef acaba de hacer su primer disco de jazz alrededor del ritmo rara haitiano, el movimiento de la diáspora y un homenaje a Quincy Jones, y Glasper ya está metido dentro de esa música en tres temas. Juntarlos durante Robtober convierte el proyecto en un pequeño laboratorio en vivo: improvisación de jazz frente a un músico que durante toda su carrera ha tratado el Caribe, el hip-hop, el pop y la música global como un solo lenguaje poroso.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los cuatro sets si Nueva York entra en el corredor. Las dos noches dan margen para incorporarlo a un viaje más amplio por la ciudad sin obligar a reorganizar todo el recorrido del noreste alrededor de un solo horario.
